description: DramaBuddy is a general-purpose comic-drama creation tool for everyone — just provide a novel or an idea, and it automatically generates the script, characters, and storyboard videos, so you can easily create your own comic-drama.

display.description_en: DramaBuddy is a general-purpose comic-drama creation tool for everyone — just provide a novel or an idea, and it automatically generates the script, characters, and storyboard videos, so you can easily create your own comic-drama.
display.description_zh: 阅文漫剧助手（DramaBuddy）是一个人人可用的通用漫剧制作工具——只需提供小说或创意，就能自动生成剧本、角色与分镜视频，轻松做出属于自己的漫剧。
examples_en: Turn this novel into a sub-3-minute comic-drama with script, character trio views and storyboard videos
Generate a 9:16 anime video on the canvas, theme: a girl running in the rain
Generate a 16:9 character design with front, side and back views
Use this character image as reference to generate a 5-second talking video
Preview the point cost of all canvas nodes, confirm before running generation
examples_zh: 把这篇小说做成 3 分钟内的漫剧，自动出剧本、角色三视图和分镜视频
帮我在画布上生成一段 9:16 的动漫视频，主题是少女在雨中奔跑
生成一张 16:9 的角色三视图设定图，含正面、侧面、背面
用这张角色图做参考，生成 5 秒的说话视频
预览当前画布所有节点的积分，确认后再执行生成
display.name: 阅文漫剧助手
